source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “While waiting at a railroad” and ends with “before the intersection until clear”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At a solid white line,” and ends with “special situation requires a change”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Pavement markings identify lane paths,” and ends with “pedestrian areas and stopping positions”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Yellow center markings” and ends with “in opposite directions”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A left turn on a” and ends with “to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “During a green-arrow turn, watch” and ends with “on red from another direction”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A right turn on red” and ends with “barred by a prohibiting sign”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Left Turn Yield On Green” and ends with “with yielding to oncoming traffic”?
source_cards.back: Left Turn Yield On Green permits the turn only with yielding to oncoming traffic.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Avoid swinging left before a” and ends with “to pass on the right”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Make a right turn from” and ends with “simultaneous turns from multiple lanes”?
source_cards.back: Make a right turn from the rightmost lane unless markings permit simultaneous turns from multiple lanes.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a left turn, avoid” and ends with “traffic approaching from the left”?
source_cards.back: For a left turn, avoid cutting across the corner into the path of traffic approaching from the left.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook's safest direction reversal” and ends with “most left turns across traffic”?
source_cards.back: The handbook's safest direction reversal is a right turn followed by travel around the block, avoiding most left turns across traffic.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a reverse two-point turn,” and ends with “before backing toward the driveway”?
source_cards.back: For a reverse two-point turn, signal right, stop and check beside and behind the vehicle before backing toward the driveway.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When centered in the driveway” and ends with “only when clear after signaling”?
source_cards.back: When centered in the driveway during a reverse two-point turn, straighten the wheels and stop; select drive, check both ways and turn left only when clear after signaling.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a forward two-point turn,” and ends with “of the driveway or alley”?

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “In a forward two-point turn,” and ends with “signal right and select reverse”?
source_cards.back: In a forward two-point turn, stop after the rear clears the road edge; check all directions, signal right and select reverse.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Begin a three-point turn by” and ends with “at the road's right side”?
source_cards.back: Begin a three-point turn by checking mirrors, signaling right and stopping at the road's right side.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the first crossing of” and ends with “and stop across the road”?
source_cards.back: For the first crossing of a three-point turn, signal left and check traffic and the left blind spot; when clear, steer hard left and stop across the road.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the reverse leg of” and ends with “hard right turn and stop”?
source_cards.back: For the reverse leg of a three-point turn, check traffic and both blind spots; when clear, reverse with a hard right turn and stop.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For the final leg of” and ends with “lane and ensure signal cancellation”?
source_cards.back: For the final leg of a three-point turn, select drive, signal left and check traffic and blind spots; when clear, turn left into the new direction's right lane and ensure signal cancellation.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before a permitted U-turn, wait” and ends with “right into the intended path”?
source_cards.back: Before a permitted U-turn, wait for a large gap in both directions and watch vehicles turning right into the intended path.

source_cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A center turning lane does” and ends with “from the school-bus stopping rule”?
